title: Install timing chains, guide rails, ramps and tensioners

notices.text: All new ramps, rails and chains — this is not the place to reuse. New O-rings on every ramp bolt, and clean and lightly grease the bolts as you go. The 3.6 is a three-chain layout: crank-to-IMS, plus one chain per bank. Compress and pin the hydraulic tensioners before installing them; never fit a pumped-up tensioner. Consider the billet IMS chain tensioner paddle upgrade in place of the plastic original. Verify every rail is fully seated and every retaining pin is captured before the covers go on.

steps.text: Install timing chains, guide rails, ramps and tensioners.

fasteners.name: Chain tensioners

stages.label: M27 x 2: 80 Nm (59 ft-lb), tensioner to crankcase and tensioner to cylinder head alike.

fasteners.note: Tensioners are hydraulic; compress and pin before installation, release only after the chains are on. M96/01 edition value; the 3.6 tensioners carry different part numbers, confirm against the torque book page.
